dashboard.name: Program Reach
dashboard.description: Who the programme reaches: caseload size, who is in it, and the jobs the businesses behind it support.

cards.name: Clients reached by country
cards.description: Mapped on ISO-2 codes, which is what the built-in world map matches on — the marts are keyed on ISO-3.
cards.sql:
select c.iso2_code as country, p.clients_total as clients
from mart_client_portfolio p
inner join stg_countries c on p.country_iso3 = c.iso3_code
order by clients desc

cards.name: Inclusion shares by country
cards.description: Share of the caseload that is women, youth and displaced.
cards.sql:
select country_iso3, women_share_pct, youth_share_pct, displaced_share_pct
from mart_client_portfolio
order by displaced_share_pct desc

cards.name: Jobs supported by country
cards.description: Total jobs, and how many are held by women and by displaced people.
cards.sql:
select country_iso3, jobs_supported, jobs_held_by_women, jobs_held_by_displaced
from mart_client_portfolio
order by jobs_supported desc

cards.name: Programme against country context
cards.description: Caseload next to the displaced population hosted and GDP growth — the operational picture against the macro one.
cards.sql:
select country_name,
       clients_total,
       clients_displaced,
       businesses_active,
       jobs_supported,
       par30_pct,
       displaced_hosted,
       displaced_clients_per_10k_hosted,
       gdp_growth_pct
from mart_country_program_context
order by clients_total desc
